description: Painted sprite for the patrol rook (?art=paint): one whole image, eyes painted in. Step 1 paints a full-body game pose from the reference crop, the style sheet and the SVG rig's pose; step 2 removes the background. Then tools/art/sprite.mjs trims it, thickens the outer outline and writes src/assets/sprites/patrol-rook.webp.

steps.name: pose
steps.prompt: Full-body game sprite, painted as one single whole image, of the royal patrol ROOK from the first image, painted in the art style of the second image (a character select sheet). Use the third image only for the full-body pose and chunky proportions, not for its style. SUBJECT: the bulkiest royal guard. An enormous steel great-helm shaped like a castle keep: straight sides with square battlements cut into its top edge, a bold gold cross over the eye slit with two dark slits, a few breathing holes, no face visible. Massive rounded royal-blue pauldrons with gold rims, a royal-blue breastplate with a gold ridge, a gold belt, steel gauntlets, short dark boots. A halberd held upright in his right fist on the right side of the figure, standing well clear of the helm with a gap of background between them: a long straight wooden shaft, a narrow steel spear spike on top, a small gold collar, and one small crescent axe blade that points away from him to the right, never toward the helm. The steel gauntlet fist clearly wraps around the shaft at waist height, the shaft rises straight up above the fist so the blade sits level with the battlements, and the shaft continues below the fist toward the ground. His left arm hangs relaxed at his left side with a closed gauntlet fist; neither arm crosses his chest. Standing, three-quarter view facing right, feet visible, chunky and big-headed: the keep helm is about half the figure's height. Bold simple shapes with few interior lines: flat plate armour, no chainmail texture. EYES: a small glinting white dot eye is painted inside each dark eye slit of the helm, so he clearly looks out to the right. POSE: a natural, anatomically correct pose. Each arm hangs from its own shoulder, the elbows bend the natural way and the hands sit at the ends of the arms; nothing is backwards, reversed or twisted. The weapon is gripped firmly in the front fist with the fingers wrapped round it, never floating. SILHOUETTE: one clean, readable silhouette with simple chunky shapes and few interior lines, nothing thin dangling off it. A VERY thick black outer outline runs all the way round the whole silhouette, about twice as thick as the inner lines, so the figure reads clearly at 48 pixels tall. STYLE to match the second image exactly: bold flash-era 2D brawler cartoon, very thick even black outlines, flat fills, one hard cel shadow, crisp white highlights on metal, polished royal blue with gold trim, no damage. One character only, centred, on a plain flat light grey background (#d8d8d8), no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no frame.
